summary: Teacher Portal testing completed. All 13 backend API tests passed. Frontend UI testing verified: Teacher login redirects to /teacher/dashboard, Dashboard shows courses/students/reviews/attendance stats, Mis Cursos page shows 2 assigned courses (Comunicación, Ciencias Naturales), Asistencia page shows teacher's assigned section (A), Mi Perfil page shows teacher info with stats (2 Cursos, 1 Secciones, 2 Asignaciones). Role-based access control working for admin routes (teacher redirected back to teacher portal). Minor security issue found: teacher can access student portal routes.

security_issues.issue: Teacher can access student portal routes (/school/:subdomain/student). The ProtectedRoute component doesn't enforce role-based access control for student routes.
security_issues.recommendation: Add role check to student routes: if user.role !== 'student', redirect to appropriate portal
